versions.changelog: v1.5.2: GTM agent opportunities API, fetch pains/insights/leads from bound project, plan schema 2.
Dashboard generate must write a Build-in-Public draft (share.bip.posts). Do not wait for picture_confirmed or a tweet prompt. A null share.bip hides the BIP card and share buttons.
Local GTM dashboard, deterministic readiness scorecard, and Build-in-Public drafts from completed milestones. Plan schema 2 adds dashboard fields; existing strategy is preserved.

1.4.1: Skill updates auto-apply at the start of each new session; no founder confirmation. Strategy in .gtm/ is preserved. 1.4.0: A project token is required before coaching (binding stays free). Bound /status includes billing, first-project sample evidence, and a timed CTA so Premium is asked only after the sample pauses.

Persist the full Skill bundle into the current agent's skills folder so later chats can call GTM Coach in natural language. Keep plan, journal, and token in workspace .gtm/; switching agents reuses that memory. Skill refresh overwrites this host's persisted copy. Do not re-init an existing plan.
Board-first CMO loop: one stage SOP, channel SOP only on dive, picture hints, and Reddit replies via the NicheReach extension.
Adds a post-value free project connection flow for deeper project-aware coaching and live capabilities.
